verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official CLI (postman-cli on npm), documented extensively for running collections, mocks, governance checks, CI/CD integration, and explicitly for giving coding agents CLI context for API discovery and code generation — and hands-on probe confirms it installs and runs headlessly via npx. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) review of the CLI's agentic/AI-native usage beyond Postman's own docs.
